long_biography.plain_text:
Van Merksteijn represents the second generation of a Dutch steel business founded by his father. He took control from his brother in 2006. He then developed the group into a major producer of reinforcement mesh, fencing panels and galvanized wire, with factories in the Netherlands, Belgium and France. As owner and director, he has backed automation, capacity growth and lower-emission steelmaking plans.

Motorsport became a second defining arena. Van Merksteijn competed in endurance racing and rallying through the team that bore his name. Driving a Porsche RS Spyder with Jos Verstappen and Jeroen Bleekemolen, he won the LMP2 class at the 2008 24 Hours of Le Mans. The result helped secure the Le Mans Series class title. His son, Peter van Merksteijn Jr., followed a separate rally career.
